verses.sloka: स्वबलं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम्।भ्रातऽंश्च निहतान् दृष्ट्वा शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् ।। ६.७१.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: svabalaṁ vyathitaṁ dṛṣṭvā tumulaṁ romaharṣaṇam।bhrāta'ṁśca nihatān dṛṣṭvā śakratulyaparākramān ।। 6.71.1 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.
translations.hindi: श्री ॥ श्रीमद्रामायणपारायणोपक्रमः हि प्पणी-सनातनधर्म के अन्तर्गत जिन वैदिकसम्प्रदायो में श्रीमद्रा मायण का पारायण होता है, उन्हीं सम्प्रदायों के अनुसार उपक्रम और समापन क्रम प्रत्मेक खण्ड के आदि और अन्त में क्रमशः दे दिए गए हैं |] च्छ श्रीव ष्णव सम्प्रदाय! ' कूजस्त राम रामेति मधुरं मधुराक्षरम्‌ । आरुह्य कविताशाखां बन्दे वाल्मीकिकोकिलम्‌

verses.sloka: पितृव्यौ चापि सन्दृश्य समरे सन्निषूदितौ।युद्धोन्मत्तं च मत्तं च भ्रातरौ राक्षसर्षभौ ।। ६.७१.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: pitṛvyau cāpi sandṛśya samare sanniṣūditau।yuddhonmattaṁ ca mattaṁ ca bhrātarau rākṣasarṣabhau ।। 6.71.2 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.

verses.sloka: चुकोप च महातेजा ब्रह्मदत्तवरो युधि।अतिकायो ऽद्रिसङ्काशो देवदानवदर्पहा ।। ६.७१.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: cukopa ca mahātejā brahmadattavaro yudhi।atikāyo 'drisaṅkāśo devadānavadarpahā ।। 6.71.3 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.

verses.sloka: स भास्करसहस्रस्य सङ्घातमिव भास्वरम्।रथमास्थाय शक्रारिरभिदुद्राव वानरान् ।। ६.७१.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa bhāskarasahasrasya saṅghātamiva bhāsvaram।rathamāsthāya śakrārirabhidudrāva vānarān ।। 6.71.4 ।।

translations.english: Adorned with a crown, Ravana glowing like a thousand suns collected together mounted the chariot and darted towards Vanaras.

verses.sloka: स विस्फार्य महच्चापं किरीटी मृष्टकुण्डलः।नाम विश्रावयामास ननाद च महास्वनम् ।। ६.७१.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa visphārya mahaccāpaṁ kirīṭī mṛṣṭakuṇḍalaḥ।nāma viśrāvayāmāsa nanāda ca mahāsvanam ।। 6.71.5 ।।

translations.english: Adorned with crown, and polished earrings, twanging his bow, proclaimed his name and roared sounding aloud.

verses.sloka: तेन सिंहप्रणादेन नामविश्रावणेन च।ज्याशब्देन च भीमेन त्रासयामास वानरान् ।। ६.७१.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tena siṁhapraṇādena nāmaviśrāvaṇena ca।jyāśabdena ca bhīmena trāsayāmāsa vānarān ।। 6.71.6 ।।

translations.english: By that lionroar, and proclamation of his name (by the sound of the twang) frightening the Vanaras he struck terror.

verses.sloka: ते दृष्ट्वा देहमाहात्म्यं कुम्भकर्णो ऽयमुत्थितः।भयार्ता वानराः सर्वे संश्रयन्ते परस्परम् ।। ६.७१.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: te dṛṣṭvā dehamāhātmyaṁ kumbhakarṇo 'yamutthitaḥ।bhayārtā vānarāḥ sarve saṁśrayante parasparam ।। 6.71.7 ।।

translations.english: Those Vanaras seeing the huge body thought, "This is Kumbhakarna, who has got up and come'. Out of fear, they sought the help of one another.

verses.sloka: ते तस्य रूपमालोक्य यथा विष्णोस्त्रिविक्रमे।भयाद्वानरयूथास्ते विद्रवन्ति ततस्ततः ।। ६.७१.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: te tasya rūpamālokya yathā viṣṇostrivikrame।bhayādvānarayūthāste vidravanti tatastataḥ ।। 6.71.8 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara troops, observing his form resembling the Trivikram form assumed by Vishnu, the monkey troops fled here and there in panic.

verses.sloka: ते ऽतिकायं समासाद्य वानरा मूढचेतसः।शरण्यं शरणं जग्मुर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजमाहवे ।। ६.७१.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: te 'tikāyaṁ samāsādya vānarā mūḍhacetasaḥ।śaraṇyaṁ śaraṇaṁ jagmurlakṣmaṇāgrajamāhave ।। 6.71.9 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras were deluded on reaching the huge body and went to Sri Rama to seek refuge.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽतिकायं काकुत्स्थो रथस्थं पर्वतोपमम्।ददर्श धन्विनं दूराद्गर्जन्तं कालमेघवत् ।। ६.७१.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'tikāyaṁ kākutstho rathasthaṁ parvatopamam।dadarśa dhanvinaṁ dūrādgarjantaṁ kālameghavat ।। 6.71.10 ।।

translations.english: Then Kakutstha saw from a distance form of huge body looking like a mountain, wielding bow, rumbling like a cloud at universal destruction.
translations.hindi: आञ्जनेयमतिपाटलानन्ं काख्नाद्रिकमनीयविग्रहम्‌ । यारिजञाततरुमूलवासिनं भावयामि पबमाननन्दनम्‌ ॥5)॥ यन्न यत्र रघुनाथकीतेनं तत्र तत्र कृतमस्तकाञ्जलिम्‌ । बाष्पबारिपरिपणंलोचनं मारुत नमत राक्षसान्तकम्‌ ।।&।। वेदवेद्ये परे पुंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे बेदः प्राचेतसादासीत्‌ साचषाद्रामायणात्मना

verses.sloka: स तं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं राघवस्तु विसिष्मिये।वानरान् सान्त्वयित्वा ऽथ विभीषणमुवाच ह ।। ६.७१.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṁ rāghavastu visiṣmiye।vānarān sāntvayitvā 'tha vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha ।। 6.71.11 ।।

translations.english: Raghava the great, seeing the form of a huge body, was amazed, reassured by the Vanaras, and spoke to Vibheeshana.

verses.sloka: को ऽसौ पर्वतसङ्काशो धनुष्मान् हरिलोचनः।युक्ते हयसहस्रेण विशाले स्यन्दने स्थितः ।। ६.७१.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ko 'sau parvatasaṅkāśo dhanuṣmān harilocanaḥ।yukte hayasahasreṇa viśāle syandane sthitaḥ ।। 6.71.12 ।।

translations.english: "Who is he, the yelloweyed, resembling a mountain, seated in the broad chariot drawn by a thousand horses?"

verses.sloka: य एष निशितैः शूलैः सुतीक्ष्णैः प्रासतोमरैः।अर्चिष्मद्भिर्वृतो भाति भूतैरिव महेश्वरः ।। ६.७१.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ya eṣa niśitaiḥ śūlaiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ prāsatomaraiḥ।arciṣmadbhirvṛto bhāti bhūtairiva maheśvaraḥ ।। 6.71.13 ।।

translations.english: "Who is he in the midst, with sharp tridents and shining spears, like Maheswara surrounded by beings?"

verses.sloka: कालजिह्वाप्रकाशाभिर्य एषो ऽतिविराजते।आवृतो रथशक्तीभिर्विद्युद्भिरिव तोयदः ।। ६.७१.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: kālajihvāprakāśābhirya eṣo 'tivirājate।āvṛto rathaśaktībhirvidyudbhiriva toyadaḥ ।। 6.71.14 ।।

translations.english: "Who is he, gleaming like the tongues of time spirit (Kala spirit), with flashes of javelins, encircled with lightning and looking like a cloud shining very bright?"

verses.sloka: धनूंषि चास्य सज्यानि हेमपृष्ठानि सर्वशः।शोभयन्ति रथश्रेष्ठं शक्रचाप इवाम्बरम् ।। ६.७१.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhanūṁṣi cāsya sajyāni hemapṛṣṭhāni sarvaśaḥ।śobhayanti rathaśreṣṭhaṁ śakracāpa ivāmbaram ।। 6.71.15 ।।

translations.english: "His bows decorated with gold on the back, are like a rainbow in the sky on all sides and makes the chariot excellent."

verses.sloka: क एष रक्षश्शार्दूलो रणभूमिं विराजयन्।अभ्येति रथिनां श्रेष्ठो रथेनादित्यतेजसा ।। ६.७१.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ka eṣa rakṣaśśārdūlo raṇabhūmiṁ virājayan।abhyeti rathināṁ śreṣṭho rathenādityatejasā ।। 6.71.16 ।।

translations.english: "The tiger among the Rakshasas seated in the chariot is the foremost car warrior. He is illuminating the battlefield like the brightness of the Sun, resplendent like Sun 's rays. By his arrows he is illuminating the ten directions. The Rahu emblem on top of the pole of the chariot is very splendid."
translations.hindi: वेदवेद्ये परे पुंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे । वेदः प्राचेतसादासीरसाक्षाद्रामायणात्मना

verses.sloka: ध्वजशृङ्गप्रतिष्ठेन राहुणा ऽभिविराजते।सूर्यरश्मिनिभैर्बाणैर्दिशो दश विराजयन् ।। ६.७१.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhvajaśṛṅgapratiṣṭhena rāhuṇā 'bhivirājate।sūryaraśminibhairbāṇairdiśo daśa virājayan ।। 6.71.17 ।।

translations.english: "The tiger among the Rakshasas seated in the chariot is the foremost car warrior. He is illuminating the battlefield like the brightness of the Sun, resplendent like Sun 's rays. By his arrows he is illuminating the ten directions. The Rahu emblem on top of the pole of the chariot is very splendid."
translations.hindi: वेदवेद्ये परे पुंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे । वेदः प्राचे तसादासीत्साच्षाद्रामायणात्मना

verses.sloka: त्रिणतं मेघनिर्ह्रादं हेमपृष्ठमलङ्कृतम्।शतक्रतुधनुःप्रख्यं धनुश्चास्य विराजते ।। ६.७१.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: triṇataṁ meghanirhrādaṁ hemapṛṣṭhamalaṅkṛtam।śatakratudhanuḥprakhyaṁ dhanuścāsya virājate ।। 6.71.18 ।।

translations.english: "His bow with three curves, covered with gold, decorated, is close to a thundering cloud, casting its splendour."

verses.sloka: सध्वजः सपताकश्च सानुकर्षो महारथः।चतुस्सादिसमायुक्तो मेघस्तनितनिस्वनः ।। ६.७१.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sadhvajaḥ sapatākaśca sānukarṣo mahārathaḥ।catussādisamāyukto meghastanitanisvanaḥ ।। 6.71.19 ।।

translations.english: "His chariot with standard, flag and axletree is a great one driven by four charioteers emitting sound like the rumblings of clouds."

verses.sloka: विंशतिर्दश चाष्टौ च तूण्यो ऽस्य रथमास्थिताः।कार्मुकानि च भीमानि ज्याश्च काञ्चनपिङ्गलाः ।। ६.७१.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: viṁśatirdaśa cāṣṭau ca tūṇyo 'sya rathamāsthitāḥ।kārmukāni ca bhīmāni jyāśca kāñcanapiṅgalāḥ ।। 6.71.20 ।।

translations.english: "This chariot has twenty quivers, ten frightening bows, and eight bow strings of golden colour lay arranged in the chariot."

verses.sloka: द्वौ च खड्गौ रथगतौ पार्श्वस्थौ पार्श्वशोभितौ।चतुर्हस्तत्सरुयुतौ व्यक्तहस्तदशायतौ ।। ६.७१.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: dvau ca khaḍgau rathagatau pārśvasthau pārśvaśobhitau।caturhastatsaruyutau vyaktahastadaśāyatau ।। 6.71.21 ।।

translations.english: "It has two swords off our cubits and ten cubits long swords provided with hilts hanging on its sides as decoration."

verses.sloka: रक्तकण्ठगुणो धीरो महापर्वतसन्निभः।कालः कालमहावक्त्रो मेघस्थ इव भास्करः ।। ६.७१.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: raktakaṇṭhaguṇo dhīro mahāparvatasannibhaḥ।kālaḥ kālamahāvaktro meghastha iva bhāskaraḥ ।। 6.71.22 ।।

translations.english: "Wearing red garland s round the neck, brave, like a mountain in form, dark with large mouth, like death, like sun veiled by clouds he seems."

verses.sloka: काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाभ्यां भुजाभ्यामेष शोभते।शृङ्गाभ्यामिव तुङ्गाभ्यां हिमवान् पर्वतोत्तमः ।। ६.७१.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: kāñcanāṅgadanaddhābhyāṁ bhujābhyāmeṣa śobhate।śṛṅgābhyāmiva tuṅgābhyāṁ himavān parvatottamaḥ ।। 6.71.23 ।।

translations.english: "By adorning armlets, his both arms are like high peaks of Himalaya mountain shining away."

verses.sloka: कुण्डलाभ्यां तु यस्यैतद्भाति वक्त्रं शुभेक्षणम्।पुनर्वस्वन्तरगतं पूर्णं बिम्बमिवैन्दवम् ।। ६.७१.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: kuṇḍalābhyāṁ tu yasyaitadbhāti vaktraṁ śubhekṣaṇam।punarvasvantaragataṁ pūrṇaṁ bimbamivaindavam ।। 6.71.24 ।।

translations.english: "He who shines like the full moon between two Punarvasu stars, his auspicious eyes and countenance shines with both earrings."

verses.sloka: आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो त्वमेनं राक्षसोत्तमम्।यं दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे भयार्ता विद्रुता दिशः ।। ६.७१.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ācakṣva me mahābāho tvamenaṁ rākṣasottamam।yaṁ dṛṣṭvā vānarāḥ sarve bhayārtā vidrutā diśaḥ ।। 6.71.25 ।।

translations.english: "Oh! Vibheeshana, a mighty armed one! Show me that foremost of Rakshasas, whom all Vanaras feared and fled in all directions."

verses.sloka: स पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण रामेणामिततेजसा।आचचक्षे महातेजा राघवाय विभीषणः ।। ६.७१.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa pṛṣṭo rājaputreṇa rāmeṇāmitatejasā।ācacakṣe mahātejā rāghavāya vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.71.26 ।।

translations.english: Interrogated by the highly brilliant prince Raghava, energetic Vibheeshana revealed.

verses.sloka: दशग्रीवो महातेजा राजा वैश्रवणानुजः।भीमकर्मा महोत्साहो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।। ६.७१.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: daśagrīvo mahātejā rājā vaiśravaṇānujaḥ।bhīmakarmā mahotsāho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 6.71.27 ।।

translations.english: "The tenheaded and highly brilliant king Ravana, who is the brother of Vysravana, is of terrible deeds and highly exploitative."

verses.sloka: तस्यासीद्वीर्यवान् पुत्रो रावणप्रतिमो रणे।वृद्धसेवी श्रुतिधरः सर्वास्त्रविदुषां वरः ।। ६.७१.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasyāsīdvīryavān putro rāvaṇapratimo raṇe।vṛddhasevī śrutidharaḥ sarvāstraviduṣāṁ varaḥ ।। 6.71.28 ।।

translations.english: "To him was born a blessed son, valiant one, compeer of Ravana, who served elders, learned and well versed in sastras."

verses.sloka: अश्वपृष्ठे रथे नागे खड्गे धनुषि कर्षणे।भेदे सान्त्वे च दाने च नये मन्त्रे च सम्मतः ।। ६.७१.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: aśvapṛṣṭhe rathe nāge khaḍge dhanuṣi karṣaṇe।bhede sāntve ca dāne ca naye mantre ca sammataḥ ।। 6.71.29 ।।

translations.english: "He is best in riding on horseback, on elephant back and in the use of sword and bow. He is capable of sowing dissension, making peace, giving charity and statecraft."

verses.sloka: यस्य बाहू समाश्रित्य लङ्का वसति निर्भया।तनयं धान्यमालिन्या अतिकायमिमं विदुः ।। ६.७१.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: yasya bāhū samāśritya laṅkā vasati nirbhayā।tanayaṁ dhānyamālinyā atikāyamimaṁ viduḥ ।। 6.71.30 ।।

translations.english: "He is known as Atikaya, son of Dhanyamalini. Lanka remains fearless on his shoulders, you may know."

verses.sloka: एतेनाराधितो ब्रह्मा तपसा भावितात्मना।अस्त्राणि चाप्यवाप्तानि रिपवश्च पराजिताः ।। ६.७१.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: etenārādhito brahmā tapasā bhāvitātmanā।astrāṇi cāpyavāptāni ripavaśca parājitāḥ ।। 6.71.31 ।।

translations.english: "By penance on supreme self he propitiated Brahma, who blessed him with mystic missiles by way of boons by which his enemies were subdued."

verses.sloka: सुरासुरैरवध्यत्वं दत्तमस्मै स्वयम्भुवा।एतच्च कवचं दिव्यं रथश्चैषो ऽर्कभास्वरः ।। ६.७१.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: surāsurairavadhyatvaṁ dattamasmai svayambhuvā।etacca kavacaṁ divyaṁ rathaścaiṣo 'rkabhāsvaraḥ ।। 6.71.32 ।।

translations.english: "Exemption from death from gods and demons was given to him and all this wonderful shield and chariot as bright as the sun."

verses.sloka: एतेन शतशो देवा दानवाश्च पराजिताः।रक्षितानि च रक्षांसि यक्षाश्चापि निषूदिताः ।। ६.७१.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: etena śataśo devā dānavāśca parājitāḥ।rakṣitāni ca rakṣāṁsi yakṣāścāpi niṣūditāḥ ।। 6.71.33 ।।

translations.english: "By this (boon) hundreds of Devatas and demons were defeated by him, Yakshas were killed, nay Rakshasas were protected."

verses.sloka: वज्रं विष्टम्भितं येन बाणैरिन्द्रस्य धीमतः।पाशः सलिलराजस्य रणे प्रतिहतस्तथा ।। ६.७१.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vajraṁ viṣṭambhitaṁ yena bāṇairindrasya dhīmataḥ।pāśaḥ salilarājasya raṇe pratihatastathā ।। 6.71.34 ।।

translations.english: "Here is strong Atikaya, a wise son of Ravana, bull among Rakshasas, who is a subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas, by whom thunderbolt of Indra was obstructed firmly in battle and likewise the noose of Varuna was repelled in war."

verses.sloka: एषो ऽतिकायो बलवान् राक्षसानामथर्षभः।रावणस्य सुतो धीमान् देवदानवदर्पहा ।। ६.७१.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣo 'tikāyo balavān rākṣasānāmatharṣabhaḥ।rāvaṇasya suto dhīmān devadānavadarpahā ।। 6.71.35 ।।

translations.english: "Here is strong Atikaya, a wise son of Ravana, bull among Rakshasas, who is a subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas, by whom thunderbolt of Indra was obstructed firmly in battle and likewise the noose of Varuna was repelled in war."

verses.sloka: तदस्मिन् क्रियतां यत्नः क्षिप्रं पुरुषपुङ्गव।पुरा वानरसैन्यानि क्षयं नयति सायकैः ।। ६.७१.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadasmin kriyatāṁ yatnaḥ kṣipraṁ puruṣapuṅgava।purā vānarasainyāni kṣayaṁ nayati sāyakaiḥ ।। 6.71.36 ।।

translations.english: "Oh, best of men! Quickly make efforts to put an end to him before he puts down Vanara army."

verses.sloka: ततो ऽतिकायो बलवान् प्रविश्य हरिवाहिनीम्।विस्फारयामास धनुर्ननाद च पुनःपुनः ।। ६.७१.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'tikāyo balavān praviśya harivāhinīm।visphārayāmāsa dhanurnanāda ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.71.37 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, mighty Atikaya entered the monkey army, twanged his bow again and again and made a loud noise.

verses.sloka: तं भीमवपुषं दृष्ट्वा रथस्थं रथिनां वरम्।अभिपेतुर्महात्मानो ये प्रधाना वनौकसः ।। ६.७१.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ bhīmavapuṣaṁ dṛṣṭvā rathasthaṁ rathināṁ varam।abhipeturmahātmāno ye pradhānā vanaukasaḥ ।। 6.71.38 ।।

translations.english: Observing the dreadful enemy seated on the chariot, the foremost of the great Vanaras rushed towards him.

verses.sloka: कुमुदो द्विविदो मैन्दो नीलः शरभ एव च।पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च युगपत् समभिद्रवन् ।। ६.७१.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: kumudo dvivido maindo nīlaḥ śarabha eva ca।pādapairgiriśṛṅgaiśca yugapat samabhidravan ।। 6.71.39 ।।

translations.english: Kumuda, Dwivida, Mainda, Neela, even Sarabha, all at once assailed him with trees and mountain peaks.

verses.sloka: तेषां वृक्षांश्च शैलांश्च शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः।अतिकायो महातेजाश्चिच्छेदास्त्रविदां वरः ।। ६.७१.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ vṛkṣāṁśca śailāṁśca śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ।atikāyo mahātejāścicchedāstravidāṁ varaḥ ।। 6.71.40 ।।

translations.english: Atikaya, endowed with extraordinary energy, efficient in the use of weapons, shattered the trees and rocks hurled by the Vanaras with his arrows adorned with gold.

verses.sloka: तांश्चैव सर्वान् स हरीन् शरैः सर्वायसैर्बली।विव्याधाभिमुखः सङ्ख्ये भीमकायो निशाचरः ।। ६.७१.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁścaiva sarvān sa harīn śaraiḥ sarvāyasairbalī।vivyādhābhimukhaḥ saṅkhye bhīmakāyo niśācaraḥ ।। 6.71.41 ।।

translations.english: The powerful night ranger of terrible form, pierced all monkeys who were facing him in the battlefield with iron arrows.

verses.sloka: ते ऽर्दिता बाणवर्षेण भग्नगात्राः प्लवङ्गमाः।न शेकुरतिकायस्य प्रतिकर्तुं महारणे ।। ६.७१.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: te 'rditā bāṇavarṣeṇa bhagnagātrāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ।na śekuratikāyasya pratikartuṁ mahāraṇe ।। 6.71.42 ।।

translations.english: The monkeys were hard pressed by Atikaya's hail of arrows. Their limbs broke and were unable to resist.

verses.sloka: तत्सैन्यं हरिवीराणां त्रासयामास राक्षसः।मृगयूथमिव क्रुद्धो हरिर्यौवनदर्पितः ।। ६.७१.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatsainyaṁ harivīrāṇāṁ trāsayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ।mṛgayūthamiva kruddho hariryauvanadarpitaḥ ।। 6.71.43 ।।

translations.english: Just as a young lion with youthful pride would strike a group of deer, the enraged Rakshasa struck the army of monkey heroes.

verses.sloka: स राक्षसेन्द्रो हरिसैन्यमध्ये नायुध्यमानं निजघान कञ्चित्।उपेत्य रामं सधनुः कलापी सगर्वितं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे ।। ६.७१.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa rākṣasendro harisainyamadhye nāyudhyamānaṁ nijaghāna kañcit।upetya rāmaṁ sadhanuḥ kalāpī sagarvitaṁ vākyamidaṁ babhāṣe ।। 6.71.44 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa lord, wielding a weapon in the midst of the monkey army, indeed did not strike any, but armed with bow and quiver went with pride towards Rama and spoke.

verses.sloka: रथे स्थितो ऽहं शरचापपाणिर्न प्राकृतं कञ्चन योधयामि।यश्चास्ति कश्चिद्व्यवसाययुक्तो ददातु मे क्षिप्रमिहाद्य युद्धम् ।। ६.७१.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: rathe sthito 'haṁ śaracāpapāṇirna prākṛtaṁ kañcana yodhayāmi।yaścāsti kaścidvyavasāyayukto dadātu me kṣipramihādya yuddham ।। 6.71.45 ।।

translations.english: "I am with a bow and arrow seated in the chariot. Indeed, I am not strong in fighting with common warriors. Whoever is interested to fight now can come speedily to fight with me."

verses.sloka: तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य चुकोप सौमित्रिरमित्रहन्ता।अमृष्यमाणश्च समुत्पपात जग्राह चापं च ततः स्मयित्वा ।। ६.७१.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tattasya vākyaṁ bruvato niśamya cukopa saumitriramitrahantā।amṛṣyamāṇaśca samutpapāta jagrāha cāpaṁ ca tataḥ smayitvā ।। 6.71.46 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Atikaya, Saumithri the destroyer of enemies, became angry, not enduring and not able to tolerate went towards him taking a sword.

verses.sloka: क्रुद्धः सौमित्रिरुत्पत्य तूणादाक्षिप्य सायकम्।पुरस्तादतिकायस्य विचकर्ष महद्धनुः ।। ६.७१.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: kruddhaḥ saumitrirutpatya tūṇādākṣipya sāyakam।purastādatikāyasya vicakarṣa mahaddhanuḥ ।। 6.71.47 ।।

translations.english: Furious Saumithri, springing up, took up his arrow from the quiver, stretching to full length before he discharged the arrow.

verses.sloka: पूरयन् स महीं शैलानाकाशं सागरं दिशः।ज्याशब्दो लक्ष्मणस्योग्रस्त्रासयन् रजनीचरान् ।। ६.७१.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: pūrayan sa mahīṁ śailānākāśaṁ sāgaraṁ diśaḥ।jyāśabdo lakṣmaṇasyograstrāsayan rajanīcarān ।। 6.71.48 ।।

translations.english: The twang of Lakshmana filled the mountains, earth, ocean, and all directions striking terrible fear in the night ranger.

verses.sloka: सौमित्रेश्चापनिर्घोषं श्रुत्वा प्रतिभयं तदा।विसिष्मिये महातेजा राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजो बली ।। ६.७१.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: saumitreścāpanirghoṣaṁ śrutvā pratibhayaṁ tadā।visiṣmiye mahātejā rākṣasendrātmajo balī ।। 6.71.49 ।।

translations.english: Then the extraordinarily energetic and powerful son of Rakshasa king was in turn frightened at the sound of Saumithri's bow and was astonished.

verses.sloka: अथातिकायः कुपितो दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमुत्थितम्।आदाय निशितं बाणमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.७१.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: athātikāyaḥ kupito dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamutthitam।ādāya niśitaṁ bāṇamidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.71.50 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Atikaya, furious Lakshmana sprang up and took a sharp shaft and spoke as follows.

verses.sloka: बालस्त्वमसि सौमित्रे विक्रमेष्वविचक्षणः।गच्छ किं कालसदृशं मां योधयितुमिच्छसि ।। ६.७१.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: bālastvamasi saumitre vikrameṣvavicakṣaṇaḥ।gaccha kiṁ kālasadṛśaṁ māṁ yodhayitumicchasi ।। 6.71.51 ।।

translations.english: "O Saumithri! You are valiant but young, not able to discriminate. I am equal to the Lord of death. Why do you desire to comb at with me?"

verses.sloka: नहि मद्बाहुसृष्टानामस्त्राणां हिमवानपि।सोढुमुत्सहते वेगमन्तरिक्षमथो मही ।। ६.७१.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: nahi madbāhusṛṣṭānāmastrāṇāṁ himavānapi।soḍhumutsahate vegamantarikṣamatho mahī ।। 6.71.52 ।।

translations.english: The shafts discharged from my arm can't be borne, by the Himalayas, even the atmosphere between the sky and earth can't bear the force.

verses.sloka: सुखप्रसुप्तं कालाग्निं निबोधयितुमिच्छसि।न्यस्यचापं निवर्तस्व मा प्राणान् जहि मद्गतः ।। ६.७१.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sukhaprasuptaṁ kālāgniṁ nibodhayitumicchasi।nyasyacāpaṁ nivartasva mā prāṇān jahi madgataḥ ।। 6.71.53 ।।

translations.english: "Why do you want to arouse the fire of dissolution sleeping comfortably? Return, casting away your bow, without confronting. Go away."

verses.sloka: अथवा त्वं प्रतिष्टब्धो न निवर्तितुमिच्छसि।तिष्ठ प्राणान् परित्यज्य गमिष्यसि यमक्षयम् ।। ६.७१.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: athavā tvaṁ pratiṣṭabdho na nivartitumicchasi।tiṣṭha prāṇān parityajya gamiṣyasi yamakṣayam ।। 6.71.54 ।।

translations.english: "Or else if you want to oppose and not return, give up your life and proceed to Yama's abode."

verses.sloka: पश्य मे निशितान् बाणानरिदर्पनिषूदनान्।ईश्वरायुधसङ्काशांस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणान् ।। ६.७१.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: paśya me niśitān bāṇānaridarpaniṣūdanān।īśvarāyudhasaṅkāśāṁstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇān ।। 6.71.55 ।।

translations.english: "See my sharp shafts capable of reducing enemy's pride like Ishwara's trident, ornamented with polished gold."

verses.sloka: एष ते सर्पसङ्काशो बाणः पास्यति शोणितम्।मृगराज इव क्रुद्धो नागराजस्य शोणितम्।इत्येवमुक्त्वा सङ्क्रुद्धः शरं धनुषि सन्दधे ।। ६.७१.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa te sarpasaṅkāśo bāṇaḥ pāsyati śoṇitam।mṛgarāja iva kruddho nāgarājasya śoṇitam।ityevamuktvā saṅkruddhaḥ śaraṁ dhanuṣi sandadhe ।। 6.71.56 ।।

translations.english: "These arrows are like serpents and can drink your blood just as an angry lion drinks the blood of elephants. Therefore, I tell you", said Atikaya to Lakshmana."

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा ऽतिकायस्य वचः सरोषं सगर्वितं संयति राजपुत्रः।स सञ्चुकोपातिबलो बृहच्छ्रीरुवाच वाक्यं च ततो महार्थम् ।। ६.७१.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā 'tikāyasya vacaḥ saroṣaṁ sagarvitaṁ saṁyati rājaputraḥ।sa sañcukopātibalo bṛhacchrīruvāca vākyaṁ ca tato mahārtham ।। 6.71.57 ।।

translations.english: Prince Atikaya, having spoken as said before, fitted his bow in wrath. Hearing the proud statement of Atikaya, the highminded Lakshmana, endowed with strength, enraged, and spoke these words of great meaning.

verses.sloka: न वाक्यमात्रेण भवान् प्रधानो न कत्थनात् सत्पुरुषा भवन्ति।मयि स्थिते धन्विनि बाणपाणौ निदर्शय स्वात्मबलं दुरात्मन् ।। ६.७१.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: na vākyamātreṇa bhavān pradhāno na katthanāt satpuruṣā bhavanti।mayi sthite dhanvini bāṇapāṇau nidarśaya svātmabalaṁ durātman ।। 6.71.58 ।।

translations.english: "You are evil minded. By mere statement you people can't become good chiefs. I stand armed with a bow and arrow. Prove your strength."

verses.sloka: कर्मणा सूचयात्मानं न विकत्थितुमर्हसि।पौरुषेण तु यो युक्तः स तु शूर इति स्मृतः ।। ६.७१.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā sūcayātmānaṁ na vikatthitumarhasi।pauruṣeṇa tu yo yuktaḥ sa tu śūra iti smṛtaḥ ।। 6.71.59 ।।

translations.english: "Reveal yourself by action not by indication. You do not deserve it. He who is with prowess is a right hero."

verses.sloka: सर्वायुधसमायुक्तो धन्वी त्वं रथमास्थितः।शरैर्वा यदि वाप्यस्त्रैर्दर्शयस्व पराक्रमम् ।। ६.७१.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvāyudhasamāyukto dhanvī tvaṁ rathamāsthitaḥ।śarairvā yadi vāpyastrairdarśayasva parākramam ।। 6.71.60 ।।

translations.english: "You are seated in the chariot with all kinds of weapons collected. By that alone you do not become capable. Show your capacity."

verses.sloka: ततः शिरस्ते निशितैः पातयिष्याम्यहं शरैः।मारुतः कालसम्पक्वं वृन्तात्तालफलं यथा ।। ६.७१.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śiraste niśitaiḥ pātayiṣyāmyahaṁ śaraiḥ।mārutaḥ kālasampakvaṁ vṛntāttālaphalaṁ yathā ।। 6.71.61 ।।

translations.english: "Then I will strike down his head with sharp arrows and throw him just as ripened palm fruit drops in the process of time."

verses.sloka: अद्य ते मामका बाणास्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः।पास्यन्ति रुधिरं गात्राद्बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् ।। ६.७१.६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya te māmakā bāṇāstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ।pāsyanti rudhiraṁ gātrādbāṇaśalyāntarotthitam ।। 6.71.62 ।।

translations.english: "Now, you will drink the blood ejected from your neck by the holes made with my pointed arrows decked with polished gold."
